reason: A research literature workbench for searching curated papers, verifying bibliographic metadata, retrieving BibTeX, and saving local session snapshots through bounded Field Current MCP tools.

summaries.zh: 通过受限的 Field Current MCP 工具检索研究文献、核验书目信息、获取 BibTeX，并保存本地会话快照。
summaries.en: Search curated research literature, verify bibliographic metadata, retrieve BibTeX, and save local session snapshots through bounded Field Current MCP tools.

capabilities: Searches a curated literature database through Field Current MCP tools
Verifies bibliographic information against DBLP and arXiv
Persists selected literature and BibTeX as local session snapshots
Uses a configured MCP endpoint and read token
